description: Execute declarative rigid bodies, colliders, forces, constraints and events without selecting a named physical-process template.
physical_assumptions: Objects declare body type, collision geometry, material, initial state, forces and constraints as data.
The solver owns all subsequent motion and contact state.
Scenario names and dataset folders never select runtime or verifier code.
verifier_rules: Only explicitly declared atomic trajectory assertions are evaluated.
repair_suggestions: Correct the scene primitives, solver capability requirements or declarative assertion.
